hypothesis: Source-bounded stage ownership plus unchanged R2 local compilation can produce matrix cells and evidence-certified orchestration without inferring parallelism from absent order or a join.
primary_gate: M01-M04 complete local and global semantics; short baseline retained
minimum_expected_delta: 2-WP M01 fully certified before G1; no unsupported edges
falsification: Local R2 cannot certify a required item or orchestration cannot uniquely certify owner/identity/condition
stop_rule: Progressive G0-G3; preserve failures and stop before long STANDARD. Do not weaken local semantic contracts to force row coverage.
